{{Disambig|Elite}}

==Enemies==
'''Elite''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Elite Abnormal]], a high health enemy that first appears on Wave 8 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode
**[[Elite Abnormal/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Elite Hazmat]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 24 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode
**[[Elite Hazmat/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Elite Boomer]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 21 in [[Molten Mode]]
**[[Elite Boomer/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Elite Molten]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 24 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode
**[[Elite Molten/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Frostmite]], internally named '''Elite Snowman''', an enemy that first appears on Wave 10 in [[Frost Mode]] and is summoned by the [[Permafrost]]
**[[Frostmite/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Permafrost]], internally named '''Elite Snow Golem''', an enemy that spawns [[Frostmite|Frostmites]] on death, that first appears on Wave 14 in [[Frost Mode]]
**[[Permafrost/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Elite Lead]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 15 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode and Wave 16 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode.
*[[Elite Phantom]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 22 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode and Wave 23 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode.
*[[Elite Mystery]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 33 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode and Wave 32 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode.
*[[Elite Void Rusher]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 37 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode and Wave 34 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode.
*[[Heavy Voidling]], internally named '''Elite Voidling''', an enemy that first appears on Wave 46 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode and Wave 41 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode.
*[[Elite Soul]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 42 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode and Wave 41 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode.

'''Elite''' may also refer to these event enemies:
*[[Elite Ducky]], an enemy that first appeared on Wave 21 in the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]
**[[Elite Ducky/Advanced Stats]]

==Skins==
